purpose: B0-SW before user-led vision-first optimization; no autonomous tuning.

fixed_runtime.tts: Matcha three BF16 estimator steps + FP16 Vocos
fixed_runtime.vision: Existing YOLOv8n FP32/TF32 TensorRT; YuNet and palm/hand FP32 OpenCV CPU

measurement_rules.warmup: Record cold first call separately; five untimed warmup calls per fixed input/model before warm samples. Record all initial and warmup outcomes; do not select only successful samples.
measurement_rules.order: Fixed fixture order. Sequential module calls; constant-rate replay arrivals at 10Hz and age sampling at 10Hz. Overload workload has independent scheduled arrivals and records late sends/rejections.
measurement_rules.statistics: nearest-rank P50/P95/max, raw sample count, errors and missing outcomes; no-result age samples rank after all finite ages. Report unique inputs separately from repeated inference calls.
measurement_rules.power: Record nvpmodel, clocks, thermal state and background processes at each run; preserve current MAXN and dynamic clocks; do not invoke jetson_clocks or change power mode.
measurement_rules.isolation: No builds/downloads/other tests during measurement. Isolated action DB and output directory; restore original managed services and configuration in finally.
measurement_rules.cache: Record native prompt-cache settings and actual cached-token counts; specify cold/reused process and initial session state; no silent cache disabling.
measurement_rules.instrumentation: Bench-only call-boundary timers; preserve production source and native parameters. Document timer/proxy overhead with paired uninstrumented calls and matching outputs.

scenarios.boundary: Hand landmark calls only when a palm ROI exists; report actual ROI/call count. TensorRT native wall time includes copies/synchronization; YuNet native detect includes OpenCV internal pre/post. Do not invent pure-kernel times.

metrics: latest-result age sampled independently of completion
scenarios.boundary: Only fixed replay conditions support controlled interference comparison; live camera scene is not frozen and is reported separately. No new raw private camera recordings.
Synthetic prompts are not independent audio transcriptions; this is a controlled pipeline diagnostic, not real-world ASR accuracy.
Freeze literal prompts and native request parameters in events; current max_tokens/ctx/threads/cache unchanged.
No audible playback timing or AEC claim.
Actions use an isolated DB; physical audio and real negative gesture samples remain explicitly unqualified.

deliverables: architecture and first user reproduction commands
deferred: User-deferred real gesture negative/occlusion/multi-hand quality samples
later: User-led performance optimization and five-run comparisons
